map.输入年营收、品牌利润率、行业品牌乘数等参数，计算品牌价值估值（收益法）: Enter annual revenue, brand profit margin, industry brand multiplier and similar parameters to compute the brand value (income approach)
map.用收益法估算制造/金工品牌价值。: Estimate manufacturing and metalcraft brand value with the income approach.
map.按市场份额系数调整溢价。: Adjust the premium by the market share coefficient.
map.：年收入 5000 万、品牌利润率 15% → 品牌利润 = 750 万；份额系: Annual revenue 50 million CNY and brand profit margin 15% -> brand profit = 7.5 million; share coefficient min(10/10, 5) = 1; brand value = 7.5 x multiplier 5 x years 1.2 x 1 = 45 million CNY (about 0.45 hundred million), which lands in the regional-brand tier.
map.：消费品乘数 8、科技 10、金工 5、制造 4：同利润 750 万，科技品牌价: Consumer goods multiplier 8, technology 10, metalcraft 5, manufacturing 4: at the same 7.5 million profit, a technology brand reaches 7.5 x 10 x 1.2 = 90 million, far above the manufacturing tier of 4.
map.常用收益法：品牌利润×行业乘数×年限系数×份额系数；乘数与行业、品牌强度相关，仅: Common income approach: brand profit x industry multiplier x years factor x share coefficient; the multiplier depends on the industry and brand strength, so treat it as a reference valuation only.
map.市场份额系数为何封顶 5？: Why is the market share coefficient capped at 5?
map.份额对溢价有边际递减，min(份额/10, 5) 避免垄断份额过度放大估值，使模: Share has diminishing returns on the premium; min(share/10, 5) prevents a monopoly share from inflating the valuation, making the model steadier.
